rows.note: Use 暗示 as the all-purpose noun for an indirect hint or reference.

example.english: He said the ticket was too expensive; that was actually an allusion telling us not to go.
example.traditional: 佢話張飛太貴，呢句其實係一個暗示，叫我哋唔好去。
example.jyutping: keoi5 waa6 zoeng1 fei1 taai3 gwai3 ne1 geoi3 kei4 sat6 hai6 jat1 go3 am3 si6 giu3 ngo5 dei6 m4 hou2 heoi3

rows.note: Use 影射 when the allusion indirectly points to a particular person, event, or target, often critically or satirically.

example.english: Everyone knew his article was an allusion to that corrupt legislator.
example.traditional: 大家都知佢篇文係對嗰個貪污議員嘅影射。
example.jyutping: daai6 gaa1 dou1 zi1 keoi5 pin1 man4 hai6 deoi3 go2 go3 taam1 wu1 ji5 jyun4 ge3 jing2 se6
